title: Python Screen Recorder in 10 Seconds

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing the necessary libraries for screen capture and image processing.

steps.title: Step 2: Define Function
steps.explanation: We define a function that records the screen for a given number of seconds.

steps.title: Step 3: Capture and Display
steps.explanation: This part captures the screen, converts it to OpenCV format, and displays it in a window.

steps.title: Step 4: Clean Up and Run
steps.explanation: We handle the exit condition and clean up after recording is done. Finally, we call the function to record for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Step 5: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Now you can run this code and see your screen being recorded in real time! Try it yourself!
